records.rule: reply Qxg8+ is a capture; net material -5 (before your move) at the end of Stockfish's line (10 plies), -5 vs its best line
records.explanation: Qc7 hung material: you end -5 in material. In Stockfish's lines, Rf8 (+5.4) keeps the material level; your Qc7 (-6.3) loses a rook. Rf8 moves the rook on g8 out of attack. After your Qc7, Stockfish answers Qxg8+, which takes the rook on g8, gives check and attacks the bishop on g7 and the pawn on h7.
